status: specified before scoring the external holdout
external_quality_policy: No relabelling or class-specific repair. Exclude missing or unparsable hostname and URLs containing whitespace, angle brackets or double quotes; retain other observed characters. Remove conflicting canonical keys and duplicates. Exclude any registered domain occurring anywhere in PhiUSIIL. Split remaining domains into frozen external holdout and adaptation pool before scoring.
drift_feedback_policy: ADWIN after a refit receives only errors from predictions authored by the current forest version. All revealed labels remain available for future retraining. Every original prediction is scored.
interpretation: Real archived URL records and published labels. Source-switch and stationary replays are controlled orders, not observed calendar-time drift. External holdout is never used for stream updates, threshold tuning or fitting. Within the adaptation pool, distinct URLs may recur under the same registered domain; record this dependence explicitly.
uncertainty: Model-seed standard deviation on fixed split; separate split-sensitivity results; grouped bootstrap of external domains. No claim of statistical superiority from overlapping splits.
